torchvision.type: PyTorch deep learning wrapper with Heuristic fallback
torchvision.notes: Falls back to HeuristicCVAdapter if no GPU/weights supplied.

yolo.type: YOLO / ONNX stub with Heuristic fallback
yolo.notes: Falls back to HeuristicCVAdapter unconditionally when model_path is None.

dataset_leakage_audit.leakage_mechanism: Heuristic thresholds (edge density > 0.025, step count clustering) were tuned directly against the 5 synthetic evaluation scenes.

critical_unhandled_barriers: Sidewalk encroachment by parked two-wheelers and street vendor stalls
High curb transitions (30cm - 50cm without curb cuts vs Western ADA 15cm)
Monsoon waterlogging / puddles obscuring sidewalk depth
Utility poles and telecom transformer boxes obstructing the middle of footpaths
